value.rationale: An open 2026 finite-path variation conjecture motivates a sizable natural subclass encompassing arbitrarily many disconnected positive blocks. This result strengthens the desired factor to m/n, gives an exact nonnegative runwise stability defect and a complete finite ball-density equality criterion, and identifies the first zero-run length where the proof mechanism fails by actual local re-oscillation. These are meaningful structural conclusions not a mere restatement of the conjecture, although the argument is elementary and the general conjecture is not claimed.
